# Mapping Inferred Effort by Site over Years

0\) Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
```

1\) Prepping to join Quad_master, and Survey_Effort together\

We do this to join coordinates from Survey_Efforts to the site scores in Quad_master so that we can map years and average effort in a way that makes sense.

```{r}
#Importing data for merging scores with lat-long, creates a gps key for site names
checked_prp <- read_csv(here("Outputs/Cleaned Data/opihi_surveys_effort.csv")) |>
  select(site_std, latitude, longitude) |> 
  drop_na()|>
  group_by(across(everything()))|> 
  summarise() |> #It was here ran alternate code 
  #summarise(n = n()) 
                #in order to find our offending duplicate, which was 1 count of a 2nd Le'ahi
  
  ungroup() |> #you need to ungroup to drop specific row #s
  filter(!row_number() == 21) |> #removing 1 offending Le'ahi group. I think the 'okina was different between those two which is causing downstream issues
  group_by(across(everything()))
  
quad_master <- read_csv(here("Outputs/Cleaned Data/opihi_quadrats_master.csv"))
```

2\) Marrying the Two Dataframes

```{r}
#joins the key for site names with lat/long!
effort_map <- left_join(quad_master,
                       checked_prp, by = "site_std",
                       ) |>
              mutate(year = year(as.Date(date))) |> #extract Years from date column, visualizing by day isn't pretty
              group_by(year, site_std) |>
              summarise(mean_year_score = mean(total_points), #averages the score across a year and site
              latitude = first(latitude), #first() reduces noise from possible joining errors, also joins the columns to keep them safe from the drop step
              longitude = first(longitude),
              .groups = "drop") |> #drop columns that aren't grouped
              filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) #remove any observations that have NAs to keep our map clean

```

3\) Assembling the Map Polygon (Gemini Assisted)

```{r}
# 1. Get polygon data for the Hawaiian Islands (WGS84 EPSG:4326)
hawaii_sf <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  filter(name == "Hawaii")

# Define spatial bounding box around the main Hawaiian Islands
hawaii_bbox <- c(xmin = -160.5, xmax = -154.5, ymin = 18.8, ymax = 22.5)

# 2. Build the ggplot map
p <- ggplot() +
  # Map layer: Polygon of Major Hawaiian Islands
  geom_sf(data = hawaii_sf, fill = "gray90", color = "gray50", size = 0.3) +
  # Data layer: Site dots with year frames for animation
  geom_point(
    data = effort_map,
    aes(
      x = longitude,
      y = latitude,
      fill = mean_year_score,
      frame = year,
      text = paste0(
        "Site: ", site_std, "<br>",
        "Year: ", year, "<br>",
        "Mean Score: ", round(mean_year_score, 2)
      )
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  # Color scale setup
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Mean Score") +
  # Restrict coordinates to the main island range
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(hawaii_bbox["xmin"], hawaii_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(hawaii_bbox["ymin"], hawaii_bbox["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
#mmd: brute forcing grid, tick, and label removal, we don't need to see the actual coords of sites  
  theme(    
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
#mmd: filling the background with a globe-y blue
    panel.background = element_rect(fill ="#D0E6F6", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#D0E6F6", color = NA),
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Effort Across Sites"
  )

p #inspect your polygon
```

4\) Passing the Polygon to ggplotly For HTML assembly (Gemini Assisted)

```{r}
# 3. Convert ggplot to animated Plotly widget
widget <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%

#mmd: adding in a section to color the backgrounds, gotta double up on this just to be sure plotly plays nice  
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#D0E6F6",
    plot_bgcolor  = "#D0E6F6"
  ) |>
  animation_opts(frame = 1000, transition = 300, redraw = TRUE) %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: ", font = list(color = "black")))

# 4. Save the widget to an HTML file
saveWidget(widget, file = here("Outputs", "figures", "hawaii_effort_map.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
```
